title: Fatigue in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: Fatigue in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: Which Variables Play a Role?
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the effects of biopsychosocial status, quality of life, functional status and hematological markers on fatigue in individuals with SLE.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being diagnosed with SLE according to the 2019 ACR/EULAR diagnostic criteria
* Being 18 years of age or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not being able to speak or understand Turkish fluently
* Having a psychiatric illness that will affect cooperation
* Heart failure or lung pathology that will affect daily life activities
* Additional autoimmune disease

primary.tf: Evaluations started immediately after receiving ethics committee approval and will be completed within 6 months, which is the study period.
